prompt: In a photorealistic photo of a lavish wedding reception, the scene captures a candid moment filled with life and detail. On the left side of the frame, an elderly woman in a blue shawl sits gracefully on a velvet chair, her posture upright and dignified. Next to her stands a tall waiter in a black vest, who is handing a crystal flute of champagne to a young bride in a white lace gown. The bride, positioned slightly toward the center, looks at the glass with a gentle smile while holding her bouquet of red roses tightly. To the right of the bride, a groom in a navy suit points toward the dance floor, drawing the attention of a small child in a yellow dress who stands beside him. In the background center, a large tiered cake with white frosting rests on a wooden table, surrounded by scattered rose petals. A golden retriever dog lies calmly under the table, its head resting on its paws. Near the cake, a photographer in a gray shirt kneels to capture the scene, his camera lens focused on the couple. Behind them, an older man in a tuxedo leans against a pillar, watching the festivities with amusement. A decorative vase with lilies sits on a nearby side table, adding a touch of elegance to the setting. Finally, a silver candlestick holder glimmers on the edge of the main table, reflecting the ambient light. There is no rain visible through the windows, and there is no digital clock on the wall. The composition balances the human elements with the decorative objects, creating a harmonious and realistic depiction of celebration.
